mission month october 2026 new voices of hope recently we had a parish pastoral council meeting on the theme ‘the parish of the future’, and one person mentioned they’d like to hear more ‘stories of hope’. so as october is the month of mission, i have asked a number of guest speakers to share on the following theme ‘new voices of hope for mission, shaped by the person of christ’. 1st sunday will begin with sr. ursula agge, a medical missionary of mary sr. from nigeria, whose last mission placement was in tanzania. 2nd weekend of october we will have br.

john stretton , an english john of god’s brother doing social work here. 3rd weekend is actually mission sunday weekend, and i have asked fr. doran to share with us some of his faith story then. 4th weekend either myself or rev victor will speak on our experiences as it is the bank holiday marathon weekend, and it might be hard to get here, with all the barriers. 5th and we saved the best for last — our own orla mccarthy, ppc, baptism, partnership, choir, deanery, and dublin diocesan council among other involvement reminding us mission is here, mission is now, and mission is everywhere.
maintenance & mission are the two great callings of the church connected by the invitation to evangelise.
we hope to have many more stories of hope each october shaped by their faith because we encourage and support each other on the journey.
huge thanks to all those who have helped us to begin this exciting faith-filled adventure for st. joseph’s parish.
